title: reaper-harness configuration (schema 1)
description: Generated from src/Config.psm1 (Get-HarnessConfigSpec); the validator there is authoritative. Do not edit by hand: run.ps1 -WriteSchema regenerates it.

template.description: a path relative to the configuration file, inside its directory

track.description: name of the track in the template project

fx.description: which FX of that track, counted from 1

stateFile.description: a path relative to the configuration file, inside its directory

env.description: environment variable that tells the plugin the path of its report file; set for the REAPER the harness starts only (names Windows, a runtime, REAPER or WebView2 reads are refused: docs/SAFETY.md)

fields.description: the numeric fields of the report to record and judge

pid.description: the field holding the id of the process that wrote the file: it must be the REAPER of that step

periodMs.description: how often at most the plugin writes the file, default 500

report.description: the plugin writes counts of its own to a small JSON file

reportCriterion.description: delta: how much the field grew over the stretch; value: what it reads at its end

bundle.description: VST3 bundle directory name, looked up in -PluginDir

jsfx.description: a JSFX shipped with the tool, instead of a bundle

params.description: parameter name -> value, set by name and read back by the Lua driver

states.description: named plugin states taken from a project or a file

state.description: name of a state of that plugin

params.description: parameter name -> value, set by name and read back by the Lua driver

mode.description: post: after the fader (default); pre: after the FX, before the fader; prefx: before the FX

source.description: the track carries the test signal

signal.description: this track's signal: each field given replaces the one of the top-level signal

folder.description: a REAPER folder (bus) track; its children are the following tracks that name it as parent

parent.description: name of the folder track this track belongs to

masterSend.description: master / parent send, default true; false keeps the track out of the master (or out of its folder)

block.description: audio device block size in samples

mode.description: offline: full-speed offline render; 1x: REAPER's 1x offline render, at real-time speed but still offline; online: online render, in real time. Whether a plugin is told it runs offline depends on REAPER's preference to inform plugins of the offline rendering state, which the tool does not set

items.description: offline: full-speed offline render; 1x: REAPER's 1x offline render, at real-time speed but still offline; online: online render, in real time. Whether a plugin is told it runs offline depends on REAPER's preference to inform plugins of the offline rendering state, which the tool does not set
audio device block size in samples
audio device block size in samples

anticipativeFx.description: REAPER's anticipative FX processing (default true, as REAPER ships)

runFxWhenStopped.description: REAPER's "Run FX when stopped" (default true, as REAPER ships); off, the FX of a track that is not armed and has no media are not run while stopped, nor (measured on REAPER 7.82) while playing

informOfflineState.description: REAPER's "Inform plug-ins of offline rendering state" (default true, as REAPER ships; measured on REAPER 7.82); off, a plugin is not told that a render is one

called.description: the FX chain of the tested track is run in this state (true) or not at all (false)

input.description: silent: every block the chain gets is all zeros; signal: none is

channels.description: left: signal on the left only; same: left and right equal sample for sample; different: both carry signal and differ

monitoring.description: REAPER reports input monitoring in effect on the tested track (B_RECMON_IN_EFFECT)

arm.description: the tested track is armed (it never records: the harness never starts a recording)

monitor.description: input monitoring of the tested track: off, on, or auto (REAPER's tape style: only while not playing)

samples.description: length of the observation window in device samples, default 2 x sr

plugin.description: a plugin on the tested track (once)

count.description: open and close its floating window this many times during the window

maxBlockDiff.description: the most the tested chain's blocks may differ from the device's in the window, default 4

wav.description: a path relative to the configuration file, inside its directory

channels.description: left: the source's first channel on the left, the right silent; same: the first channel on both; different: the source's two channels (default)

feed.description: the input fed to the tested track through its input FX chain: the harness test signal, or a WAV file at the scenario sample rate

compare.description: reference: with the same stem of the reference render (default unless the scenario compares with none); none: on its own

maxDiffDb.description: allowed residual in dBFS (a mix of several tracks can differ by more than full scale); absent means bit-identical

lag.description: expected lag in samples (the test render later than the reference is positive), default 0

peakMaxDb.description: the test render must not peak above this

notSilent.description: the test render must peak above -120 dBFS

rmsDb.description: channel (L, R or 1, 2, …) -> [min, max] RMS in dBFS; digital silence counts as -400

energyRatioDb.description: "A/B" -> [min, max] of RMS(A) - RMS(B) in dB

rmsChangeDb.description: channel -> [min, max] of RMS(test) - RMS(reference) in dB
